title: Grain Handling Safety Assessment
description: Free Grain Handling Safety Assessment template for agriculture you can edit online and download as PDF. Covers hazards and controls, before bin entry, approval & sign-off.

Hazards And Controls

HazardWho / what is at riskExisting controlsLSRiskAdditional controls / owner
Engulfment in flowing grainWorker entering binNever enter a bin while equipment runs; lock out; lifeline and observer
Grain dust explosionWorkers, facilityDust control, h ousekeepin g, no ignition sources, explosion venting
Oxygen deficiency and toxic gas in binsWorker entering binConfined space permit, gas testing, v entilation
Auger and conveyor e ntanglemen tOperatorsGuarding, emergency stop, lock-out
Falls from bins and laddersWorkersLadders in good condition, fall arrest, safe access
Fungal spores and dust inhalationWorkersRespirator s, ventila tion, wetting dust

Risk Rating Guide (L = Likelihood 1-5, S = Severity 1-5, Risk = L X S)

1. 1-4 Low: manage by routine procedures.

2. 5-9 Medium: add controls where reasonably practicable and monitor.

3. 10-16 High: do not start or continue until controls reduce the risk; senior approval

needed.

4. 17-25 Extreme: stop work; redesign or eliminate the hazard.

Before Bin Entry

☐ Entry permit issued; all power locked out and tagged

☐ Grain flow stopped and verified; no crusts or bridges present

☐ Atmosphere tested; ventilation running

☐ Trained observer outside; rescue plan and equipment ready

☐ Harness and lifeline worn
